artworks.title: sequence 1a
artworks.medium: acrylic on paper and 3D hand printed filament
artworks.image: /assets/uploads/My face filament on top of the watcher.jpg
artworks.alt: Expressionist portrait head in acrylic and marker, with hand printed 3D filament

artworks.title: sequence-1b
artworks.alt: Line drawing of a face in white and transparent 3D-pen filament suspended over paper with shadow creating the 3rd image

artworks.title: sequence 1c
artworks.medium: hand printed 3d filament suspended on top of wood
artworks.alt: Transparent filament portrait suspended above wood panel

artworks.title: sequence 2a
artworks.alt: Expressionist portrait head in acrylic and marker, dark hair against an orange aura

artworks.title: sequence 2b
artworks.medium: White and Transparent filament suspended to create shadow with light
artworks.alt: Line drawing of a face in transparent 3D-pen filament suspended over paper paired with sequence 2a

artworks.title: sequence 2c
artworks.medium: White and transparent filament with projected shadow
artworks.alt: Transparent filament portrait suspended above paper so the sculpted line and its projected shadow form two faces
artworks.statement: This filament construction is the three-dimensional counterpart to The Watchman, which appears in Witnesses. Here, light separates the object from the projected portrait it produces.

artworks.title: sequence 4a
artworks.alt: Elongated mixed-media portrait with wide black eyes and softly washed peach, gray, and rose passages

artworks.title: sequence 4b
artworks.alt: Black filament translation of an elongated face built across a translucent rectangular support

artworks.title: sequence 5
artworks.medium: Mixed media and filament on paper
artworks.alt: Black and white filament portrait aligned over a pink and orange painted face

artworks.title: Wire Over Face
artworks.alt: A hand-bent wire construction stands away from a framed drawing, so the object and the image beneath it are read together.
artworks.statement: A hand-bent wire construction stands away from a framed drawing, so the object and the image beneath it are read together.

artworks.title: Light State I
artworks.medium: Paint marker and mixed media on translucent paper
artworks.alt: Translucent-paper portrait in its dark backlit state, with blond hair and a face shifted toward slate blue
artworks.statement: One painting, two conditions. Front-lit, the sheet reads as a pale drawing; with the light behind it, the surface darkens and quiet colors become forceful.

artworks.title: Light State II
artworks.medium: Paint marker and mixed media on translucent paper
artworks.alt: Red-haired translucent-paper portrait in its dark backlit state
artworks.statement: The second of the paired translucent paintings, shown with light passing through from behind. Its front-lit state accompanies it as documentation.

artworks.title: Divided Light
artworks.alt: Frontal portrait divided into warm orange and cool blue planes against a blue ground

artworks.title: Green Room
artworks.alt: Asymmetrical portrait with a dark sculpted hairstyle against a turquoise green ground

artworks.title: Red on Green
artworks.alt: A red head against an acid green field, the warm and cool halves meeting without a transition.
artworks.statement: A red head against an acid green field, the warm and cool halves meeting without a transition.

artworks.title: Inward Bloom
artworks.alt: Vivid symmetrical face built from eyes, lips, leaves, and curling fluorescent lines

artworks.title: Inversion Study
artworks.alt: Orange, cyan, violet, and white expressionist portrait photographed on a wood floor

artworks.title: Inversion Study II
artworks.alt: Mauve and blue mask-like portrait with orange contours and doubled facial features

artworks.title: Inversion Study III
artworks.alt: Orange, cream, and charcoal portrait in which eyes, mouth, and surrounding fields exchange positions

artworks.title: Red Mask
artworks.alt: Angular red portrait mask with black recessed eyes against an orange ground

artworks.title: Red Witness
artworks.alt: Close expressionist portrait in red, black, orange, and pink with a dark sweep surrounding the face
artworks.statement: A close, compressed face holds the viewer inside a dark sweep of hair and red ground. Exposed lines remain visible across the features, keeping the image unsettled rather than resolved.

artworks.title: Electric Witness
artworks.alt: Brightly colored expressionist profile with wide eyes and green upright hair

artworks.title: The Watchman
artworks.alt: Linear portrait of a bald, bearded man with an elaborate moustache and green eyes

artworks.title: Messenger
artworks.alt: Pale frontal portrait marked with fine yellow and violet lines and a small bird at the shoulder

artworks.title: One Eye Open
artworks.alt: The face is cropped until only one eye, a nostril and a mouth remain, with a violet form pressing in from the right.
artworks.statement: The face is cropped until only one eye, a nostril and a mouth remain, with a violet form pressing in from the right.

artworks.title: Delicious
artworks.medium: Ink and coloured pen on paper
artworks.alt: Frontal portrait built entirely from accumulated pen strokes, the figure raising a glass toward the viewer.
artworks.statement: Frontal portrait built entirely from accumulated pen strokes, the figure raising a glass toward the viewer.

artworks.title: Look Up
artworks.alt: A head tipped back, eyes raised, the skin worked in overlapping strokes of orange, green and violet.
artworks.statement: A head tipped back, eyes raised, the skin worked in overlapping strokes of orange, green and violet.

artworks.title: Gilded Profile
artworks.medium: Marker and metallic leaf on paper
artworks.alt: A profile turned upward, the throat and jaw laid in metallic leaf against blue and yellow hatching.
artworks.statement: A profile turned upward, the throat and jaw laid in metallic leaf against blue and yellow hatching.

artworks.title: Night Caller
artworks.alt: A gaunt frontal head with heavy brows and a red mouth, resolved from a pale first state into full orange.
artworks.statement: A gaunt frontal head with heavy brows and a red mouth, resolved from a pale first state into full orange.

artworks.title: Speaker
artworks.alt: A shouting head that arrives in three passes: contour drawing, blocked pink, then the full red and orange.
artworks.statement: A shouting head that arrives in three passes: contour drawing, blocked pink, then the full red and orange.

artworks.title: Live Wire
artworks.medium: Acrylic and paint marker on paper
artworks.alt: A red head against a pale ground, then bound in turquoise and orange contour until the drawing sits on top of the painting as a second skin.
artworks.statement: A red head against a pale ground, then bound in turquoise and orange contour until the drawing sits on top of the painting as a second skin.

artworks.title: Sitting For It
artworks.alt: A pale yellow face with a violet beard, held against a flat red ground.
artworks.statement: A pale yellow face with a violet beard, held against a flat red ground.

artworks.title: Auburn
artworks.alt: Dark auburn hair sweeps around a yellow face; one eye stays drawn while the other is painted.
artworks.statement: Dark auburn hair sweeps around a yellow face; one eye stays drawn while the other is painted.

artworks.title: Soft Field I
artworks.alt: Soft red, peach, turquoise, and gray color field punctuated by small raised marks

artworks.title: Violet Study
artworks.alt: A face held just below resolution, washed in violet, with only the lips and lower lids brought forward in red.
artworks.statement: A face held just below resolution, washed in violet, with only the lips and lower lids brought forward in red.
